PLAN "12-Week Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control Program for Female Client (Type 2 Diabetes, Metformin)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve fat loss, glycaemic control, and overall fitness for T2DM"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Baseline Conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Glycemic Foundations":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full-Body with Focus on Form":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression & Glycemic Strategy":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Conditioning & Form Maintenance":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full-Body with Conditioning":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength + Metabolic Finisher":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x max rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Glycemic Modulation":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 55m "Active Recovery + Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_fly 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_light_stretch 3 minutes

NUTRITION PLAN (diabetes-specific, 12 weeks)
NUTRITION
  GOALS
    - Normalize glycemic control (HbA1c target: <7.0% if achievable with program)
    - Promote fat loss while preserving lean mass
    - Maintain medication safety with metformin (se reductions in fasting glucose)
  DAILY MACRO FRAMEWORK
    CALORIE_TARGET: "adjust to 10-20% deficit from maintenance; re-evaluate biweekly"
    CARBS: "40-45% of total calories, focus on low GI, distributed 3-4 meals per day plus post-workout"
    PROTEIN: "1.6-2.0 g/kg body weight per day"
    FATS: "25-35% of total calories, emphasize unsaturated fats"
  MEAL TIMING & ROUTINE
    - Eat every 3-4 hours to support glycemic control and satiety
    - Include lean protein, high-fiber carbs, healthy fats in each meal
    - Pre-workout snack: 15-30 g complex carbs 30-60 minutes before training
    - Post-workout: 1:2 ratio carbs:protein within 60 minutes
  GLUCOSE MANAGEMENT STRATEGIES
    - Monitor fasting glucose daily; log fasting levels each morning
    - Target pre-meal glucose: 90-130 mg/dL; post-meal <180 mg/dL (adjust per clinician guidance)
    - Hydration: 30-35 ml/kg/day; electrolyte balance as needed
    - Metformin taken as prescribed; avoid alcohol binge; discuss any hypoglycemia symptoms
  NUTRIENT TIMING TEMPLATES (sample day)
    MEAL 1 (Breakfast)
      - protein 25-40 g
      - carbs 40-60 g (low GI)
      - fats 10-20 g
    MEAL 2 (Lunch)
      - protein 25-40 g
      - carbs 40-60 g (low GI)
      - fats 10-20 g
    MEAL 3 (Snack, optional)
      - protein 15-25 g
      - carbs 15-30 g (prefer fiber-rich)
    MEAL 4 (Dinner)
      - protein 25-40 g
      - carbs 20-50 g (vegetables + small portion whole grains)
      - fats 10-20 g
  FOOD EXAMPLES (canonical within allowed vocabulary)
    - lean_protein: Not a vocabulary item; describe in plan as plain foods in guidelines (but must stay within WPL-AI; nutrition section is allowed in plan as text)
  DIABETES-SPECIFIC CONSIDERATIONS
    - Prioritize fiber-rich carbs (vegetables, legumes where appropriate) and whole grains
    - Monitor for hypoglycemia symptoms and adjust carbs around workouts
    - Coordinate with clinician for metformin timing relative to training and meals
  EDUCATION & SUPPORT
    - Weekly check-ins via plan notes for adherence and glucose tracking
    - Encourage 1 rest day per week with light activity (walking, mobility)
  NUTRITION NOTES
    - If HbA1c remains above target after Phase 3, discuss medication review with physician before increasing any intensity or duration
    - Hydration: include electrolyte balance on training days

CONNECTIONS
  - Nutrition emphasis aligned with training goals
  - Monitor progress biweekly with body weight, body composition, and qualitative energy/fatigue metrics

END PLAN
